svg.title: Andreja high-level architecture and data flows
svg.desc: Current Phase 1A components, current local conformance contracts, future gated components, six labelled trust boundaries, ten numbered data flows, a semantic provenance flow, local data custody, and extension seams.

text.tspan: Andreja high-level architecture and data flows
Ratified-plan evidence view • ADRs 0001–0005 + 0008 are Proposed • one modular-monolith deployable
User content follows policy-labelled flows only.
Never telemetry, public/help, or secret files.
Flows F1–F10 and semantic flow S1 map to the companion.
Status is always written; color only groups areas.
